purpose: Eleanor nursery wing: find the dead keeper, infer the family tragedy, search two sets of six drawers and evade the mother through connected rooms.
runtimeSurface: Existing Godot 4.5.2 Android first-person cooperative game; no engine migration

hero.role: Empty cradle establishes the mother and lost-child theme without a key-location label

exceptions: Existing interaction anchors stay fixed; furniture is intentionally asymmetric
West internal opening at X=-5 and east at X=5.5 preserve access to the keeper
One cradle in the northeast room establishes the hero hierarchy

circulation.description: 3.42 m clear central corridor, 2.4 m internal openings, two cross-room loops; player radius .32 m and ghost radius .4 m must be verified in runtime. Door sweeps and hiding entry reserves stay clear.
